newsitem.title: INDIA: State Bank of India up 7.6 pct on NSE.
newsitem.headline: State Bank of India up 7.6 pct on NSE.

text.p: Shares of State Bank of India (SBI) surged 19.10 rupees or 7.6 percent to 270 rupees on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on hectic bids by punters, traders said.
Traders said early investment buying followed by Calcutta operators squaring positions on the last day of the account was driving the share price higher.
They said operators on the NSE and Bombay bourse were building long positions ahead of SBI's $400 million GDR pricing next month.
"Some funds who missed out at the lower levels stepped in at 250/55 rupee levels but then speculators jumped on the bandwagon and the price shot up," said a trader at a foreign brokerage.
SBI shares jumped 18.75 rupees to 270.75 in Calcutta and rose 12.50 rupees to 273.75 in Bombay.
